segments.name: development and commercialization of prophylactic vaccines
segments.description: Develops, manufactures and commercializes prophylactic vaccines for infectious diseases addressing unmet medical needs for travelers and the public.
segments.evidence: The CDM evaluates all vaccine candidates and vaccine products together as a single operating segment, "development and commercialization of prophylactic vaccines".

revenueModel.text: Customers and distribution partners pay for proprietary and third-party vaccine product sales, and partners like Pfizer pay collaboration, licensing and R&D service revenues.
revenueModel.evidence: We commercialize a portfolio of proprietary and differentiated traveler vaccines, which is composed of IXIARO (also marketed as JESPECT in Australia and New Zealand), DUKORAL, and IXCHIQ.
